name: Suavidad de Piel Facial
description: Detecta suavizado artificial de piel facial en video
algorithm: Face Skin Smoothness — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial skin smoothness for video deepfake detection:

1. **Piel Región Segmentation**: Facial skin regions are segmented per frame, separating skin from eyes, eyebrows, lips, and hair. The skin regions — forehead, cheeks, nose, chin — are analyzed independently for texture quality.

2. **Textura Frecuencia Análisis**: High-frequency skin texture content is measured using local power spectral density. Natural skin contains multi-scale texture: pores (~0.5-1mm spacing), fine wrinkles, and skin grain. The method quantifies texture energy at these characteristic spatial frequencies. AI-generated skin often shows suppressed high-frequency texture — the over-smoothing artifact common in GAN-generated faces.

3. **Smoothness Gradiente Detección**: The method maps smoothness variation across the face. Natural faces show region-dependent smoothness: smoother on cheeks, more textured on the nose and forehead. Deepfake faces may show unnaturally uniform smoothness or incorrect smoothness distribution across facial regions.

4. **Piel Detail Preservation Evaluación**: Fine skin details (individual pores, hair follicles, micro-wrinkles) are evaluated for rendering quality. These details help assess whether the skin texture is photographed (with characteristic sensor-captured detail) versus rendered (often lacking sub-pixel detail or showing repetitive synthetic patterns).

5. **Temporal Piel Textura Estabilidad**: Natural skin texture is static — pores and micro-features remain in fixed positions frame-to-frame. The method tracks skin texture consistency over time. Deepfake generators may produce temporally varying skin texture where pore patterns shift, appear, or disappear between frames, creating detectable temporal texture instability.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face skin smoothness analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
